page_title: MNU 2-3 NOT | Manchester Utd v Nottingham Forest 07/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' Darren England is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+6' Lisandro Martinez (Manchester United) pounced on a rebound on the edge of the box and his shot goes a whisker over the crossbar.
90+5' Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.

90+5' A rebound on the edge of the box falls to the feet of the unmarked Marcus Rashford (Manchester United). He doesn't hesitate and shoots towards goal, but unfortunately for him it hits one of his own teammates.
90+4' Darren England shows a yellow card to Neco Williams (Nottingham) for a tough tackle.
90+1' The keeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) sacrificed accuracy for power, and thus his attempt went well over the bar.
90' We will have 7 min. of added time.
90' Here comes a substitution. Taiwo Awoniyi (Nottingham) is brought on as a substitute for Callum Hudson-Odoi.
88' The resulting corner from Mason Mount (Manchester United) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
86' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.

85' Matz Sels pulls off a fantastic save! Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) attempts to head home after a precise cross into the box. He aims his header towards the left post, but the effort is kept out.
84' Noussair Mazraoui (Manchester United) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
82' Noussair Mazraoui (Manchester United) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
79' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Chris Wood departs the field of play to be replaced by Anthony Elanga (Nottingham).
79' Substitution. Morgan Gibbs-White is replaced by Nicolas Dominguez (Nottingham).
76' Ruben Amorim decides to make a substitution. Manuel Ugarte will be replaced by Joshua Zirkzee (Manchester United).
76' The game has come to an end for Bruno Fernandes. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Mason Mount (Manchester United).
74' Lisandro Martinez (Manchester United) brings down the pass, looks up and shoots from distance, but it's straight at a defender who unwittingly blocks it.
74' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away.
69' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) is able to continue to play.
68' The game is interrupted now, Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
68' Substitution. Morato (Nottingham) in, Jota Silva out.
67' Darren England interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Ryan Yates (Nottingham). That's a free kick to Manchester Utd.
66' Ruben Amorim has decided to substitute Leny Yoro and he is replaced by Noussair Mazraoui (Manchester United).
65' Substitution. Harry Maguire (Manchester United) has come on for Matthijs de Ligt.
64' Nightmare of a shot. Amad Diallo (Manchester United) is first to a rebound inside the 6-yard box but his shot goes high and wide of the goal.
61' 2 - 3 Goal! Amad Diallo pulls the ball back for Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) on the edge of the box, and he beats the keeper with a fine strike inside the left post. 2:3.
61' The linesman signals that Chris Wood (Nottingham) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
59' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) comes onto the pitch so that Alejandro Garnacho can be given a rest.
58' Neco Williams (Nottingham) unleashes a missile of a shot towards goal, but his good effort is blocked by one of the defenders.
58' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
54' 1 - 3 Chris Wood (Nottingham) jumps for a cross and plants a perfect header inside the right post.
53' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
52' Amad Diallo (Manchester United) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the bottom left corner, but Matz Sels easily deals with the threat.
52' Chris Wood (Nottingham) gets into a great position in the box after a pass, but sends his shot just wide of the left post.

47' 1 - 2 Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) latches on to a brilliant pass and hits a poor shot towards the middle of the goal, but the ball goes into the back of the net after the goalkeeper makes a howler!
46' The second half gets underway.
45+1' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
42' OFF THE BAR! Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) strikes a brilliant shot towards goal from the free kick, but his effort rattles the crossbar.

40' A free kick is awarded from a very dangerous distance. It's situated just a few metres from outside the box. Several players gather around the ball, but it seems like Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) is going to have a crack himself.
39' Darren England couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Ryan Yates (Nottingham) and blew his whistle. Free kick. Manchester Utd will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
38' A snap shot by Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) from mid-range towards the middle of the goal catches Matz Sels flat footed, but he somehow recovers and makes a brilliant save.
36' Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
36' Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders. The referee signals a corner kick to Nottingham.
34' Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
33' Jota Silva (Nottingham) lashes the ball towards goal from outside the penalty area, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar.
32' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
32' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
31' Jota Silva (Nottingham) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Darren England didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
30' Jota Silva (Nottingham) is penalised for holding. Darren England signals a set piece. Manchester Utd earn a free kick.
30' Ryan Yates (Nottingham) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Darren England blows for a foul. A free kick to Manchester Utd.
30' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
28' Jota Silva (Nottingham) leaps high to meet a lofted pass around the penalty spot, but his header crashes against the right post!
28' Manuel Ugarte (Manchester United) commits a rough challenge and Darren England blows his whistle for an infringement. Nottingham have a free kick.
26' Jota Silva (Nottingham) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
25' Jota Silva (Nottingham) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

23' Rasmus Hojlund (Manchester United) finds himself in a promising position after receiving an excellent pass into the box, but one of the defenders produces a timely intervention to avert the threat.
18' 1 - 1 Goal! Rasmus Hojlund (Manchester United) fires the rebound low into the middle of the goal after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:1.

18' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a golden opportunity. His low drive is headed for the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper pulls off a marvellous diving save and denies him.
17' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Darren England saw the whole situation. Nottingham are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
15' The resulting corner from Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) is cleared by the defence.
15' Amad Diallo (Manchester United) receives the ball inside the box from the resulting free kick, but fails to score as his shot is blocked by one of the defenders.
14' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) quickly takes the free kick with a short pass.
14' Jota Silva (Nottingham) makes a strong challenge and Darren England blows for a foul. A free kick is awarded to Manchester Utd.
13' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
12' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
11' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. It's a free kick to Nottingham in a dangerous position.
10' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United).
6' Darren England blows his whistle. Ryan Yates (Nottingham) commits a foul after dangerous play. A free kick has been awarded to Manchester Utd.
5' Rasmus Hojlund (Manchester United) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
4' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.

2' 0 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Nikola Milenkovic (Nottingham) gets on the scoresheet after converting a chance from the resulting corner kick. He finds himself some space inside the box and plants a perfect header into the top of the net. 0:1.
2' There's an opportunity for Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
2' The ball is cleared after Ryan Yates (Nottingham) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The linesman points to the corner flag, Nottingham are going to take it.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The match will be delayed due to minute of silence.
Nottingham will kick the game off.
Darren England will officiate today.
